units.source_text: 我的个性使我不得不琢磨起来，为什么我的心情会变成这样呢？

en.t: My nature made me unable to help thinking about it: why had my feelings changed like this?

units.source_text: 不对，为什么他们变成这样了呢？

en.t: No, why had they changed like this?

units.source_text: 我突然怀疑是不是死去的父母洗涤了我那迷糊的眼睛，让我一下子看清了社会呢？

en.t: I suddenly wondered whether my dead parents had washed my clouded eyes and made me see society clearly all at once.

units.source_text: 因为在我的内心深处，总是相信父母纵然离开了这个世界，也会像在世时一样爱我的。

en.t: For deep in my heart, I always believed that even after leaving this world, my parents would love me just as they had when they were alive.

units.source_text: 不过那时候，我绝不是不明事理的，

en.t: However, even then, I was by no means incapable of understanding reason,

units.source_text: 只是祖宗遗传下来的迷信思想，依然强有力地潜伏在我的血液中,至今都没有消失吧。

en.t: but the superstition handed down from my ancestors still lay powerfully hidden in my blood, and perhaps it has not disappeared even now.

units.source_text: 我独自一人去了山上，跪在父母的墓前。

en.t: I went up the mountain alone and knelt before my parents' grave.

units.source_text: 我是怀着一半哀悼、一半感激的心情给他们下跪的，

en.t: I knelt to them with feelings that were half mourning and half gratitude,

units.source_text: 仿佛躺在这冰冷的墓石下面的父母手里，还掌握着我未来的幸福。

en.t: as if my future happiness were still held in the hands of my parents lying beneath that cold gravestone.

units.source_text: 我怀着这样的心情祈求他们护佑我。

en.t: With that feeling, I prayed for them to protect me.

units.source_text: 也许你会笑话我，随你嘲笑好了，

en.t: Perhaps you will laugh at me; laugh if you like,

units.source_text: 我本来就是这样的人啊。

en.t: that is simply the kind of person I was.
